home.a_private_ai_assistant_that: A private AI assistant that runs entirely locally. Ask questions, write, create images and music, and get everyday work done.
home.movies_tv_shows_and_music: Movies, TV shows and music, organized automatically — with artwork, lyrics and subtitles.
home.a_native_redis_client_for: A native Redis client that opens instantly and stays smooth past 100,000 keys. Browse, edit and watch the server without the wait.
home.put_your_singing_on_pitch: Put your singing on pitch. One click for Auto Tune, or move every note by hand.
home.tell_modelcraft_what_you_need: Tell ModelCraft what you need, and it works your other apps for you — playing a film in Arthub, looking up keys in Keel, tuning a vocal in TuneStudio or starting a container.

home.run_linux_containers_on_your_mac: Run Linux containers on your Mac. Pick an image, set ports and folders, and it's running in seconds.
home.pages_tables_and_databases_that: Notes, tables and databases, all kept locally. Write, organize and find anything — even offline.
home.weigh_light_objects_on_your: Weigh light objects on your MacBook's trackpad. Tare, hold, count pieces and calibrate — like a real scale.
home.a_native_client_for_sql_and: A native client for SQL and vector databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Qdrant and Milvus. Browse tables and collections, edit rows, run queries and find similar vectors.

modelcraft.apple_silicon_m1_or_later: Apple silicon (M1 or later) · macOS 15 or later
modelcraft.models_run_on_device_no: Models run locally. No account, no subscription.
modelcraft.download_a_model_and_start: Download a model and start. Nothing to configure.
modelcraft.organizes_files_looks_things_up: Organizes files, looks things up online and sees a task through from start to finish.
modelcraft.generated_on_device_right_in: Generated locally, right in the conversation.
modelcraft.conversations_and_files_kept_together: Conversations and files kept together. Answers draw on the documents in each project.
modelcraft.text_images_documents_and_audio: Text, images, documents and audio — or just speak.
modelcraft.long_conversations_stay_fast_with: Long conversations stay fast, with usage visible at a glance.
modelcraft.pick_a_model_download_in: Pick a model. Download in one click
modelcraft.browse_popular_open_models_downloads: Browse popular open models. Downloads and storage are handled automatically.
modelcraft.conversations_are_processed_on_device: Conversations are processed locally. The network is used only to download models or browse the web.
modelcraft.works_your_other_apps_for: Works your other apps for you
modelcraft.modelcraft_connects_to_arthub_and: ModelCraft connects to Arthub, Cellar, Container, Keel and Quaero and acts on your behalf. Ask for a film and it starts playing; ask about a key and it looks it up in Redis. More apps will follow.
modelcraft.example_arthub: “Play the next episode of my show in Arthub”

meta.title: ModelCraft
meta.description: ModelCraft is a private AI assistant that runs entirely locally, for conversations, documents, and creating images, video and music.

modelcraft.example_tunestudio: “Auto Tune my vocal in TuneStudio, Natural style”
modelcraft.example_cellar: “Add this paper to my Reading list in Cellar”
modelcraft.give_it_a_prompt_and_a_time: Give it a prompt and a time. Every day or every week, it runs the task with your connected apps — a digest of today's notes, a movie for Friday night.
modelcraft.demo_chat_title: Ask, and it works your apps
modelcraft.demo_chat_body: Replies come from the model on your Mac. Open a reply's tool calls to see which apps it used and what each one sent back.

arthub.movies_shows_and_music_beautifully: Movies, shows and music. Beautifully organized
arthub.apple_silicon_m1_or_later: Apple silicon (M1 or later) and Intel · macOS 14 or later
arthub.add_a_folder_arthub_does: Add a folder. Arthub does the rest
arthub.resolution_and_source_tags_are: Resolution and source tags are ignored, and season folders can be named Season 01, S01 or 第一季. A corrected match is remembered.
arthub.new_and_changed_files_are: New and changed files are picked up on their own.
arthub.disconnect_a_drive_and_its: Disconnect a drive and its details remain.
arthub.moves_and_renames_on_the: Moves and renames on the same drive keep their match.
arthub.removing_a_folder_never_touches: Removing a folder never touches the original files.

meta.title: Arthub
meta.description: Arthub turns folders of movies, TV shows and music into a library, with artwork, cast, synced lyrics and subtitles.

arthub.demo_movies_body: Each title comes with its poster, cast and ratings. Press Play and the subtitles load on their own; stop halfway and it picks up where you left off.
arthub.demo_shows_body: Episodes are grouped by season, specials included, and each one remembers how far you got.
arthub.demo_music_title: Music with lyrics that follow along
arthub.demo_music_body: Browse by song, album or artist, play an album, and open Lyrics to see each line light up as it’s sung.
arthub.demo_library_body: Media lists every file in the folder and what Arthub recognized it as. Files stay where they are, and a drive that goes offline keeps its titles in the library.

keel.a_native_redis_client: A native Redis client. Fast, fluid, instant
keel.requirements: macOS 26 or later · iOS 26 or later
keel.connect_with_a_username_pick: Connect with an ACL username, pick a database and tag it with a color. SSH tunnels sign in with a password or private key, and passwords live in the Keychain.
keel.deletes_flushdb_and_other_dangerous: Deletes, FLUSHDB and other dangerous commands always ask first.
keel.delete_by_pattern_shows_the: Delete by pattern shows the matching keys first, then UNLINKs them in batches.
keel.changes_to_a_value_are: Changes to a value are applied in a transaction.
keel.strings_over_1_mb_load: Strings over 1 MB load just the beginning, so even huge values open instantly; binary values stay read-only.

meta.title: Keel
meta.description: Keel is a fast, smooth native Redis client, compatible with Valkey, Dragonfly, KeyDB and Garnet.

keel.demo_browse_body: Keys are grouped into folders by their colons. Pick one to edit its value, whatever its type, and set when it expires.
keel.demo_insights_body: Insights breaks memory down by type and key prefix, lists the largest keys, and shows the server’s clients, commands and slow log.
keel.demo_console_body: Run any Redis command in the console beside your keys. It uses its own connection, so blocking commands never stall the browser.

tunestudio.put_your_singing_on_pitch: Put your singing on pitch. No studio required
tunestudio.made_for_beginners_with_room: Made for beginners, with room to grow — Auto Tune when you want it done, hands-on editing when you want control.
tunestudio.wav_mp3_and_m4a: WAV, MP3 and M4A — open a file or drop it on the window.
tunestudio.a_pitch_curve_over_a: Your pitch drawn as a line above piano keys, with every held note shown as a block.
tunestudio.natural_balanced_or_robotic: Natural, Balanced or Robotic. Click again to hear the original.
tunestudio.drag_notes_up_or_down: Drag notes up or down, hold ⌥ for finer steps, and split or merge notes.
tunestudio.your_original_file_is_never: Your original file is never changed, and every edit can be undone.
tunestudio.wav_for_best_quality_or: WAV for the best quality, or M4A for a smaller file.
tunestudio.gently_nudges_notes_toward_pitch: gently nudges notes toward pitch, so your voice keeps its character.
tunestudio.puts_every_held_note_on: puts every held note on pitch and keeps your vibrato.
tunestudio.snaps_notes_flat_onto_pitch: snaps notes flat onto pitch for the classic electronic sound.
tunestudio.choose_a_recording_of_a: Choose a recording of a single voice. Less background music works best.
tunestudio.click_auto_tune_in_the: Click Auto Tune in the toolbar, or drag any note where you want it.
tunestudio.press_space_to_play_not: Press Space to play. Not happy? ⌘Z takes you back.
tunestudio.save_the_result_as_a: Save the result as a new WAV or M4A file.

meta.title: TuneStudio
meta.description: TuneStudio puts your singing on pitch — Auto Tune in one click, or adjust every note by hand.

tunestudio.demo_hint: Try it: press Play to hear the take, turn on Auto Tune or pick a style, drag a note up or down, and play it again. Hover the curve to read each pitch.

meta.title: Container
meta.description: Container runs Linux containers natively on your Mac, in a light app that opens in seconds.

container.linux_containers_native_on_your_mac: Linux containers, native on your Mac
container.requirements: macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon
container.choose_host_ports_or_leave: choose host ports, or leave them unpublished.
container.set_cpu_cores_and_memory: set CPU cores and memory for each container.
container.type_an_image_name_like: Type an image name like nginx and pull it from the registry.
container.ports_and_volumes_are_already: Ports and volumes are already filled in from the image. Adjust what you need.
container.click_create_and_start_and: Click Create and Start, then open localhost in your browser.
container.pick_a_folder_read_only: pick a folder from your Mac, read-only if you like.
container.demo_containers_body: Start, pause and stop containers, or create one from a local image. Select one to watch its stats and logs, browse its files or open a shell.
container.demo_images_body: Type a name like nginx:latest to pull it. Each image shows its size, layers and the ports it exposes, ready to create a container from.
container.demo_networks_body: Create networks and join containers to them. Each network has its own mode and subnet, and shows how many containers are on it.
container.demo_volumes_body: Keep data in a volume and it stays when the container is deleted. See how much space each one uses.

meta.title: Cellar
meta.description: Cellar is a notes and databases app that keeps everything local. Write, organize and link your ideas, no internet needed.

cellar.notes_and_databases_that_stay: Notes and databases that stay local
cellar.write_notes_build_databases_and: Write notes, build databases and link them together. Every page is made of blocks you can type, drag and nest.
cellar.headings_lists_to_dos_code: Headings, lists, to-dos, code, images, diagrams and mind maps — type “/” to add any of them.
cellar.custom_properties_relations_rollups_and: Add your own fields, link databases together and let totals add up on their own. Any page can hold one.
cellar.table_board_and_list_views: Table, board, gallery, list, calendar, timeline and chart, each with its own filters and sorts.
cellar.k_finds_any_page_or: ⌘K finds any page or row, in English or Chinese, and suggests related pages too.
cellar.bring_in_markdown_obsidian_vaults: Bring in Markdown, Obsidian vaults, Notion exports, CSV and Word documents.
cellar.pages_to_markdown_html_or: Pages to Markdown, HTML or Word; databases to CSV.
cellar.turn_any_page_into_a: Turn any page into a database. Rows are pages too, so each one can hold notes of its own. Link databases together and let the totals take care of themselves.
cellar.every_page_and_row_is: Every page, row and block is saved locally, in a single file that's yours.
cellar.cellar_never_connects_to_the: Cellar never connects to the internet. Diagrams draw offline, too.
cellar.edits_deletes_and_whole_imports: Edits, deletes and whole imports each come back with ⌘Z.
cellar.export_to_open_formats_whenever: Export to open formats whenever you like. No lock-in.
cellar.demo_hint: Try it: type in a page, press “/” for block types, add a page with +, or drag cards on the Tasks board.

meta.title: Quaero
meta.description: Quaero is a fast, native client for SQL and vector databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Qdrant and Milvus.

quaero.the_console_opens_beside_the: The console opens beside the table you are looking at and runs in the same database. Press ⌘Return to run, and see the row count and time of each statement.
quaero.passwords_are_kept_in_the: Passwords are kept in the system Keychain, never in settings or logs.
quaero.require_encryption_or_verify_the: Require encryption, or verify the server's certificate and host name too.
quaero.the_mysql_and_postgresql_protocols: The MySQL and PostgreSQL protocols are built in, and Qdrant and Milvus are reached through their REST APIs. No drivers to install.
quaero.sql_null_shows_as_a: SQL NULL shows as a badge, so it never looks like the text “NULL”.
quaero.a_native_client_for_sql_and: A fast, native client for SQL and vector databases
quaero.meaning_not_just_matches: Search by meaning, not just matches
quaero.connect_to_qdrant_or_milvus: Connect to Qdrant or Milvus, or a PostgreSQL table with pgvector. Find Similar Rows sends the right search for each — an ORDER BY with the distance you pick, or the database's own query — and lists the nearest rows with their distance.
quaero.demo_sql_body: Open a table to browse its rows, filter them with conditions, and double-click a cell to edit it. Table Info shows its columns and CREATE statement.
quaero.demo_console_body: The console opens beside the table. Run SQL and the results appear under it; on a vector database it sends REST requests instead.
quaero.demo_vector_body: Collections open like tables, and each vector shows as a color strip you can read at a glance. Right-click one to find the most similar rows.

meta.title: Pinch
meta.description: Pinch turns a MacBook's Force Touch trackpad into a small scale for light objects, with tare, hold, counting mode and calibration.

pinch.turn_your_trackpad_into_a: Turn your trackpad into a scale
pinch.requirements: macOS 27 or later · a Mac with a Force Touch trackpad
pinch.a_real_scale_on_your: A real scale on your desk
pinch.the_force_touch_trackpad_already: The Force Touch trackpad already feels how hard you press. Pinch reads that pressure and shows it as weight, with the keys you'd find on a kitchen scale.
pinch.slanted_seven_segment_digits_a: Slanted seven-segment digits, a Stable light and a Net sign, just like an electronic scale.
pinch.zero_the_reading_with_whatever: Zero the reading with whatever is already on your finger, so you only weigh what you add.
pinch.freeze_the_reading_and_keep: Freeze the reading and keep it on screen after you lift your finger.
pinch.weigh_ten_pieces_once_and: Weigh ten pieces once, and Pinch tells you how many are on the pad.
pinch.calibrate_with_one_known_weight: Calibrate with a single known weight, like a coin. The result is saved for next time.
pinch.grams_ounces_carats_troy_ounces: Grams, ounces, carats, troy ounces and grains, up to 1,000 g.
pinch.press_tare_add_ten_identical: Turn on counting mode, press Tare, add ten identical pieces and press Tare again. Pinch learns the weight of one piece and shows whole pieces from then on. Every key has a shortcut you can change in Settings.
pinch.rest_one_finger_lightly_on: Rest one finger lightly on the trackpad. Don't click.
pinch.press_tare_so_your_finger: Press Tare so your finger itself counts as zero.
pinch.place_the_object_on_your: Place the object on your fingertip or nail.
pinch.when_the_reading_settles_the: When it settles, Stable lights up and the trackpad taps once.
pinch.demo_hint: Try it: click the trackpad to rest a finger, put things from the desk on it, then tare, hold, count paper clips, or calibrate with the coin.
